cucina-itameshi.name: Cucina Itameshi
cucina-itameshi.note: Italian-Japanese. Menu is a PDF on the site that rotates — homepage is the safe link.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: Falstaff 92/100. The menu says it outright: dishes are meant for sharing, 4–6 for two people. So 6–9 plates for three.

sections.label: The one they build the menu around

items.name: COSTATA — dry-aged rib eye, n'duja butter, negi
items.desc: The kitchen flags it as a two-person sharing centrepiece.

items.name: Udon Cacio e Pepe
items.desc: Handmade udon, pecorino, egg yolk, pepper. The dish that goes viral for this place.

items.name: XO Beef Carpaccio
items.desc: Wasabi, parmesan, onion tsukemono.

items.name: Kushiyaki di Pollo
items.desc: Chicken thigh skewers, house sriracha.

items.name: Lasagne Poruchini
items.desc: Tan tan bolognese, porcini béchamel.

items.name: Iberico Chashu
items.desc: Flambéed pork neck, tare, hazelnuts.

orderCard.suggested: Italo Kimchi + Iberico Chashu → XO Carpaccio, Udon Cacio e Pepe, Lasagne, Kushiyaki → Costata → Tiramisu
orderCard.skip: The pizza. Plates arrive as they're ready, not in courses — order in two waves. The €6.50pp Gedeck (bread, miso butter, water) is effectively compulsory.
orderCard.allergy: The current menu has NO shrimp. Only shellfish is Pasta Fredda (cockles — mollusc). The menu rotates every few weeks, so flag the allergy when confirming.

klyo.name: Klyo
klyo.note: Riverfront canal bar on the Donaukanal.

albertina.name: Albertina
albertina.note: Monet-to-Picasso collection, Dürer drawings, Habsburg state rooms. ~90 min is plenty.

zum-schwarzen-kameel.name: Zum Schwarzen Kameel — Wiener Brasserie
zum-schwarzen-kameel.note: Ground floor brasserie. Kitchen until 10 PM. Vienna institution since 1618.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: Do the standing bar out front FIRST — see the note at the bottom. It's the best 30 minutes in Vienna.

items.name: Der legendäre Beinschinken
items.desc: Hand-carved bone-in ham, fresh horseradish, house bread. One plate, three forks, as a table starter.

items.name: Original Wiener Schnitzel (veal)
items.desc: One piece is already a full portion. Two pieces €26.50.

items.name: Original Tafelspitz vom Rind
items.desc: Root veg, Rösterdäpfel, apple-horseradish.

items.name: Beef Tartar
items.desc: Hand-cut, avocado, buttered toast.

items.name: Eierschwammerl à la crème mit Gnocchi
items.desc: Chanterelle season is peak right now — this is the seasonal play.

orderCard.suggested: Brötchen standing up out front first, then Beinschinken for the table, then a schnitzel, a Tafelspitz and the Eierschwammerl
orderCard.skip: Nothing — but don't sit down before doing the Feinkost counter. The famous Brötchen (open sandwiches) are NOT on the brasserie menu. They're at the counter out front, ordered by pointing, ~€2.50–4.50 each. Beinschinken with horseradish, roastbeef with artichoke, curry-egg with chives. 3–4 each with a glass of Grüner ≈ €20–25pp.
orderCard.allergy: THIS IS THE RISKY ONE. Avoid: Shrimpscocktail €21.90, Rosa Garnelen €23.90, Gebratene Garnelen €22.50, Garnelenspieße €22.50, Caesar mit Garnele €22.00, Fischplatte €37.50, and Hors-d'œuvre 'Kameel' €33 (plated off the same cold station). Austrian menus mark crustaceans allergen B. Everything recommended above is clean.
orderCard.footer: ~€70–80pp for dinner and drinks, plus €20–25 at the counter.

verde.name: Verde
verde.note: Pizza and spritzes. Menu PDFs rotate — site is the safe link.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: An afternoon graze, not a meal. Two pizzas cut and shared between three.

items.name: Dominiks Lieblingspizza
items.desc: Tomato, warm buffalo mozzarella, basil, pine nuts, truffle oil, datterini.

items.name: Pizza San Daniele
items.desc: Prosciutto di San Daniele, rocket, Grana.

items.name: Pizza Diavolo
items.desc: Spicy salami, peperoncino, garlic.

orderCard.suggested: Antipasti piccolo + two pizzas cut and shared + beers
orderCard.skip: The €29–34 truffle pizzas. And arrive after 3pm — breakfast service runs till 15:00 Saturdays.
orderCard.allergy: Avoid: Linguine ai Gamberi €32.50, Risotto ai Gamberi €32.50, Linguine Frutti di Mare €24.50, Pizza Frutti di Mare €21.50 — all marked allergen B.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: The whole reason to stop is the street window, not the café.

items.name: Kaiserschmarrn
items.desc: Cooked fresh in a copper pan in the Kohlmarkt-facing window while you watch. No queue, no €35 sit-down bill. Splits three ways as a taste.

items.name: Demels Sachertorte mit Schlag
items.desc: Apricot jam only under the glaze, no middle layer — the contested rival to Hotel Sacher's.

items.name: Annatorte
items.desc: What Viennese regulars actually order.

orderCard.skip: No reservations, ever. Queues build 12:00–16:00 — the window bypasses all of it.

krypt.name: Krypt
krypt.note: Falstaff 90 pts 2026. Historic vaulted cellar, 23-foot marble-and-walnut counter, elevator down. Fri until 2–3 AM.

volksgarten.name: Volksgarten Club
volksgarten.dressCode: It's a club — no gym gear. Jeans and a decent shirt are fine.

cafe-landtmann.name: Café Landtmann
cafe-landtmann.note: Opened 1873. Sidewalk-level terrace on the Ring. Freud's café.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

items.name: 'Die Legende' — Wiener Schnitzel vom Kalb
items.desc: Parsley potatoes, salad, cranberries. The plain €29 version is the same schnitzel with just a lemon — the upgrade buys the whole classic plate. Worth it once.

items.name: Rindsgulasch
items.desc: Serviettenknödel, gulasch crunch, pickle.

items.name: Getrüffelte Eiernockerl
items.desc: Shaved truffle, baked organic egg, crispy onion. The sleeper — genuinely Viennese, and Americans never order it.

items.name: Kaiserschmarrn mit Zwetschkenröster
items.desc: Order it WITH the mains — takes 20 minutes and one feeds three.

orderCard.skip: Saturday means no lunch menu — the €16.90 soup+main deal is Mon–Fri only. If you're hitting Demel later, skip cake here.
orderCard.allergy: Only crustacean is a '+ grilled prawns €9' add-on. Just don't add it.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

items.name: Wiener Schnitzel vom Kalb
items.desc: Lugeck serves VEAL — legally the only thing that can be called Wiener Schnitzel. The famous plate-overhanging Figlmüller schnitzel round the corner is pork ('Schnitzel Wiener Art'). This is the grown-up version, in a far less touristy room.

items.name: Beef Tatar, große Portion
items.desc: Avocado, toast, butter.

items.name: Ribeye Dry Aged Höllerschmid 400g
items.desc: Or Zwiebelrostbraten €27.90 and save €31.

items.name: Getrüffelte Erdäpfelsuppe
items.desc: One, three spoons.

items.name: Kaiserschmarrn
items.desc: Order with the mains.

items.name: Lugeck Spezial vom Fass 0.5l
items.desc: Their own house draft.

orderCard.skip: The €49.90 truffle schnitzel and the €31.90 wagyu burger. You're here for schnitzel.
orderCard.allergy: No crustaceans on the menu at all. (The octopus on the specials card is a mollusc.)

figlmueller.name: Figlmüller Bäckerstraße
figlmueller.note: Fallback for Lugeck — same schnitzel, same family.

rathausplatz-film-festival.name: Film Festival am Rathausplatz
rathausplatz-film-festival.note: FREE. Jul 4 – Sep 6, 2026. 11 AM – midnight, food until 11 PM. 25+ food stalls, giant screen, concert films.

esmee.name: Esmée
esmee.note: Ask for the Orangerie room — that's the whole point. Order smart.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: Reviews are genuinely split. The charcuterie, shellfish and rôtisserie are excellent; the vegetable plates are where the money disappears.

sections.label: Everyone who liked this place liked this dish

items.name: Esmée toast
items.desc: Gruyère, truffle duxelles, jamón ibérico, 4 pcs. Order two rounds — 4 pieces doesn't split three ways.

items.name: Grilled topside of turbot on the bone
items.desc: Serves 2–4, carved at the table.

items.name: Steak au poivre
items.desc: Flambéed tableside.

items.name: Gougères
items.desc: Comté and black truffle.

items.name: Spicy fried chicken
items.desc: Smoked paprika and ranch.

orderCard.skip: Green salad 180, tomato carpaccio 185, French asparagus 355 — that's $28–55 for a side, and it's the section people complain about. Ask the price of the Prime Cuts Selection before ordering; it's listed at market price with no number. Water is 50 DKK a head, not free.
orderCard.footer: ~850 DKK ($134) pp food; 1,100–1,400 DKK with drinks.

groeften.name: Grøften
groeften.note: Danish institution since 1874, inside Tivoli. Open til ~23:00. ⚠️ Smørrebrød is served 12:00–15:30 ONLY — as a dinner replacement the open sandwiches are not available.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

items.name: Grøftens Snapsemenu
items.desc: Curry herring, a glass of aquavit, and UNLIMITED skipperlabskovs — the salt-beef-and-potato mash Danish sailors ate. Most authentically Danish thing in the city at that price, and ad libitum means three hungry Americans get their money's worth.

orderCard.warn: Smørrebrød is served 12:00–15:30 ONLY. If you use this as the dinner backup, the open sandwiches are not available.
orderCard.skip: Nothing — each smørrebrød has a recommended aquavit printed next to it. Lean into that, it's the point of the place.
orderCard.footer: ~430 DKK ($67) pp, VAT and service included.

ps-bar-grill.name: PS Bar & Grill
ps-bar-grill.note: Closes 11 PM Sundays. One round and out.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

sections.label: The set beats à la carte

items.name: Build Your Own Brunch
items.desc: À la carte the four sections cost 205, so the set is a real discount. Build it: sourdough + yoghurt with blueberry and coconut granola + scrambled eggs with tomato and chive + homemade spicy Danish beef merguez. The merguez is the reason to be here.

items.name: Breakfast Plate
items.desc: Fried egg, spicy merguez, broccolini, baked cherry tomatoes, avocado, sourdough.

items.name: Hand-brew filter
items.desc: Home of the 2026 Danish Barista Champion. Get one as filter to taste what he actually does.

orderCard.skip: Nothing. Add havarti and marmalade to your bread for +15 — cheap upgrade. Brunch runs Mon–Fri until 14:00.

sokkelund.name: Sokkelund
sokkelund.note: Kitchen closes at 9 PM. Do not be late.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

items.name: Steak Frites
items.desc: 400g ribeye, fried padrón peppers, red wine sauce, fries with béarnaise. Their fries are fried in peanut oil and tossed in umami salt.

items.name: Bacon & Cheese Burger 340g
items.desc: The 340 is the double — don't accidentally order the 170g single at 249.

items.name: Moules Frites
items.desc: 600g blue mussels.

items.name: Tatar starter
items.desc: Hand-cut top round, cornichons, toasted sourdough.

items.name: Gillardeau oysters combo, 3 pcs
items.desc: Natural + fried + nam jim.

items.name: Trøffel frites
items.desc: Parmesan, truffle oil.

orderCard.skip: Nothing — but burgers come medium by default. Say something if you want otherwise.

madklubben.name: Madklubben Frederiksberg
madklubben.note: Backup for Sokkelund. Same bistro energy. M3 metro straight to Citizen after.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order (if you switch here)

sections.label: Best value on the entire trip

items.name: Frederiksberg Menuen
items.desc: Four courses: bread, olives and truffle almonds → cold-smoked salmon → whole-roasted beef cuvette with red wine sauce and fries → rødgrød with vanilla ice cream.

items.name: Gillardeau oysters, 9 pcs
items.desc: That's $4.85 an oyster. Absurd.

items.name: Svinekroketter
items.desc: Pork croquettes, pepper mayo.

citizen.name: Citizen
citizen.note: Open Mondays. Cocktails & Comedy night. Ground level.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.note: World's-top-50 cocktail bar. Mon 5 PM–1 AM. No sign on the door — look for the townhouse.

reffen.name: Reffen — Copenhagen Street Food
reffen.note: 31 stalls. Open-air, industrial waterfront on Refshaleøen. Arrive at 11:30 opening on a Tuesday and you'll have it to yourselves.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: 31 stalls, each its own queue. Mains 100–180 DKK, platters 200–260, beers 60–75.

items.name: Fuego — Plato de Carne
items.desc: Argentine open-fire grill: Black Angus and house chorizo over live coals, a rustic mixed-grill platter built for sharing. Also grab one Pepito — grilled Angus sandwich with fresh chimichurri.

items.name: GOSHT — Lammeshish
items.desc: Kurdish charcoal kebab. Lamb shish on naan, grilled tomato, sliced onion, yoghurt sauce. Reffen's own description calls it strongly addictive. Best-value protein on the island.

items.name: HYGGE — Flæskestegssandwich
items.desc: Under the flagpole, the Danish one. Roast pork with crackling, mayo, pickled cucumber, red cabbage. Don't leave Denmark without it.

items.name: SMASHBURGER BY NICEBUNS — Brie & Onion Bliss
items.desc: Two smashed patties, caramelized and crispy onions, melted brie, honey mustard. Poutine and loaded fries on the side.

items.name: Empanada House (Criolla) · Piola (Argentine lomito) · Manila Street BBQ n Bao · Zen Dim Sum

orderCard.suggested: Land at Fuego, order the Plato de Carne, grab a table. One guy peels off to Gosht, one to Hygge. Reconvene and cut everything into thirds.
orderCard.skip: Never all stand in the same line. Three guys, three queues, one table. Arrive at 11:30 opening on a Tuesday and you'll have the place to yourselves.

broens.name: Broens Gadekøkken
broens.note: Sheltered — the rain fallback for Reffen. Opens 11:00. Gasoline Grill burgers. Note: broensgadekoekken.dk now redirects here.

warpigs.name: Warpigs Brewpub
warpigs.note: WALK-IN. Meat sells out — go earlier rather than later. Order at the counter. 23 Mikkeller taps.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order — three Texans judging Danish barbecue
orderCard.intro: Queue at the counter and order meat by weight off the board (1/4 lb = 113g). Carved to order onto a tray, sides separate. Four house sauces free on every table: Alabama, Texas (made with their own lambic and cranberries), Kansas City, Carolina. Pitmaster Adrian Claudiu Lazar; the crew did a research tour across Texas; 12–14 hour smokes on two of the largest smokers in Europe.

sections.label: The only dish that answers the question you came to answer

items.name: Half-pound of brisket
items.desc: Ask the carver for the fatty point end — that's where reviews split hardest, and the difference is which end you get. Order brisket FIRST; it's the item that runs out.

items.name: Sharing Tray
items.desc: 1 lb spareribs and sausages, ½ lb brisket and pork neck, whole chicken, 2 of every side. Sized for 3–4. Add an extra ½ lb brisket (190) so you get enough of the thing you're judging. About 413 DKK ($65) pp.

items.name: Burnt End Baked Beans / coleslaw / dill pickles
items.desc: About 333 DKK ($52) pp for roughly 1 kg of meat.

sections.label: Beers — 23 rotating taps, brewed on site (~65–95 DKK per 0.4L)

items.name: Frank The Tank
items.desc: Hazy pale ale 5.3%, the flagship. Start here.

items.name: Lazurite
items.desc: American IPA 7.4%, resin and pine. The pick against fatty brisket.

items.name: Elite Human NEIPA 6.5% · Big Drunk Baby West Coast DIPA 9%
items.desc: One of the DIPA, not three.

items.name: Smoldering Holes
items.desc: Imperial stout 10.4%, espresso and fudge. This is your dessert — order it instead of key lime pie.

orderCard.suggested: Flight order: Frank The Tank → Lazurite → Smoldering Holes. Portion math: about ½ lb (225g) of meat per person minimum.
orderCard.skip: The plain Mac and Cheese (50) — the most criticized item, described as watery, like packet mix. If you want mac, pay up for The General's (130); Burnt End Baked Beans is the better side anyway. Ribs and smoked chicken draw the most dry complaints — order ½ lb of ribs to judge, don't build the meal on them. Texas Smørrebrød at 450 is a novelty priced like a main for two.
orderCard.footer: ~$52–65 pp. The 1/4 lb portions are small — portion-to-price is the number one complaint.

tivoli.name: Tivoli Gardens
tivoli.note: Open until ~11 PM. Season runs through Sep 20.

bucherer.name: Bucherer (ex-Klarlund) — Rolex
bucherer.note: Walk-in, no appointment. Østergade 22 — may be trading from a temporary shop at No. 15 during the rebuild; the CPO boutique is also at No. 15.

politically-incorrect.name: Politically Incorrect Tours
politically-incorrect.address: Gammel Strand Metro station, 1202 København K
politically-incorrect.note: Meet at Gammel Strand Metro — look for the ORANGE UMBRELLA. Arrive 10:45.

harbour-bus.name: Harbour Bus 991/992
harbour-bus.note: ~40 DKK. Board at Nyhavn. The boat ride IS part of the fun.

luminair.name: LuminAir Rooftop
luminair.note: DoubleTree 11th floor. Walk in, no booking. Until 1 AM (2 AM Thu). NOT DeDakkas — that's in Haarlem.

greenwoods.name: Greenwoods Singel
greenwoods.note: Signature is the New Amsterdam Benedict. (Menu re-checked Aug 2026 — worth a glance on arrival, this one was harder to verify than the others.)

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

sections.label: The dish that separates this from every other Benedict in town

items.name: New Amsterdam Benedict
items.desc: NY pastrami, two poached eggs, Old Amsterdam cheese, pickles, sauerkraut, smoky hollandaise on sourdough.

items.name: Sunny Side Stack
items.desc: Fried egg, hash brown, bacon, sausage, aged cheese in a toasted muffin, cheesy beans.

items.name: Stroopwaffel Pancake Stack
items.desc: One, split three ways, for the Dutch box-tick.

orderCard.skip: Nothing — but it's walk-in only, small and canal-side. Before 11:00 or expect a queue. Coffee-and-juice place, no beer programme; save the drinking for later.

canvas-volkshotel.name: Canvas @ Volkshotel
canvas-volkshotel.note: 7th floor. Free DJ night on Thursdays. Wildcard second stop.

hannekes-boom.name: Hannekes Boom
hannekes-boom.note: Waterfront beer garden on a pier near Centraal. Canal-side beers if the group's up for it.

foodhallen.name: Foodhallen
foodhallen.note: Converted tram depot, Oud-West. 19 stalls: The Butcher burgers, Holy Fried Chicken, ramen, tacos, pizza, 3 bars. €8–16 a plate. OPENS 12:00 SHARP, walk-in only — send one guy to claim a table immediately.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: 19 stalls, each with its own till and menu — there is no central bill. Three separate bars; the Beer Bar has 60+ taps including two house brews. Walk-in only.

sections.label: Send someone to this queue first

items.name: The Butcher — 'The Daddy'
items.desc: 230g Aberdeen Angus, melted Edam, lettuce, tomato, bacon, BBQ sauce, grilled onions. Hits 20 minutes at peak.

items.name: SMOKEY GOODNESS
items.desc: Dutch pitmaster Jord Althuizen's stall: brisket, pulled pork, burnt ends. The most on-brand stall for you three.

items.name: VIETVIEW
items.desc: Caramelised pork belly bánh mì and bao. The palate-cleanser that stops this becoming three brown meals.

items.name: TAQUERIA LIMA
items.desc: Cochinita pibil tacos, 3 for about €10–14. Shares cleanly.

items.name: Also good
items.desc: Renato's (antipasti and pizza), Toko Bumbu (Indonesian satay and babi pangang), Mr Temaki, Santiago.

orderCard.suggested: One man grabs a table immediately — the raised platform at the back is best — while the other two split up and queue different stalls
orderCard.skip: Don't all order burgers. One burger, one BBQ plate, one bánh mì, one taco order is the right density for three. Order small from several stalls rather than one big meal each.

van-gogh-museum.name: Van Gogh Museum
van-gogh-museum.note: TIMED TICKETS — book ahead, they sell out. Largest Van Gogh collection in the world.

blvd020.name: BLVD020
blvd020.note: Next to the venue. WALK-IN ONLY on event days, no reservations. Be there by 5 to beat the rush.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: From 17:00 on event days the kitchen serves the Evenementenkaart ONLY — the full dinner menu is off. This short events menu IS your menu.

sections.label: Fastest ticket, and what the kitchen is built to fire at volume

items.name: Beef Burger
items.desc: Bacon, onion, tomato, cheese, house sauce. Fries included.

sections.label: The rest of the events menu

items.name: Pizza — Shoarma / Tandoori Chicken / Salami
items.desc: The fastest thing on the menu.

items.name: Kipsaté
items.desc: Chicken skewers, peanut sauce, atjar, fries.

orderCard.suggested: Arrive right at 17:00, skip starters, order all three mains at once — 2× Beef Burger + 1× Pizza Shoarma
orderCard.skip: The Ossenhaas Steak (€38.50) — slowest ticket in the kitchen, steakhouse money in a stadium forecourt, and you had a far better steak at Café-Restaurant Amsterdam the night before. Same for the carpaccio; it eats clock. Tell the server you have a show — they run this every event night and will fire the table together.
orderCard.warn: The room fills in 20 minutes after 17:00. Walk-in only on event days.

afas-live.name: AFAS Live
afas-live.note: Metro Line 54, Nieuwmarkt ↔ Bijlmer ArenA, ~15 min. TAP YOUR CARD AT THE GATE. Pre-book a taxi home.

adam-lookout.name: A'DAM Lookout
adam-lookout.note: Free ferry behind Centraal. Europe's highest swing.

amsterdamliebe.name: Amsterdamliebe Private Tour
amsterdamliebe.note: Meet at the National Monument, by the LIONS. Guide wears a RED BADGE. Arrive 11:25. Ends at Spui.

may-fair-bar.name: May Fair Bar
may-fair-bar.note: CLOSED SUNDAYS. Saturday night is the night.

dover-street-counter.name: Dover Street Counter
dover-street-counter.note: Mayfair diner. "McDonald's for oligarchs." Booking window still pending.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

sections.label: The whole thesis of the place

items.name: The Cheeseburger
items.desc: The Infatuation singles it out — a triumphant, tall burger, rare patty, perfect ratios. At £16 in Mayfair that's the point.

items.name: DSC French Dip
items.desc: Sliced roast beef, beef ragù, taleggio, pickles, jus. A multiple-napkin affair.

items.name: Grilled Half Lobster
items.desc: Herbed garlic butter, lemon, chives.

items.name: Beef Ribeye Tagliata 300g
items.desc: Black pepper, ginger, chilli, coriander.

items.name: Disco Fries
items.desc: Pickled chilli and ginger, mayo, disco jus.

items.name: Wedge & Walnuts
items.desc: Chilled iceberg, candied walnuts, ranch.

items.name: New York Cheesecake
items.desc: Flambé banana, spiced rum caramel.

items.name: Wine from £37
items.desc: Malbec Reserve Mendoza £58.

orderCard.suggested: Sit at the counter, not a table. Every review says the same — the counter is where the energy is.

hawksmoor.name: Hawksmoor Seven Dials
hawksmoor.note: Fallback for Dover Street Counter. Steak.

items.name: Porterhouse
items.desc: Order about 1.2kg (roughly £168) and split three ways — fillet and sirloin on one bone, over charcoal. Beats three separate steaks on value and drama.

items.name: Shaky Pete's Ginger Brew
items.desc: Tanqueray, lemon, ginger, London Pride, in a frosted tankard. Hawksmoor's most famous drink.

sections.label: Starters and sides — steaks come with nothing, get three

items.name: Creamed spinach
items.desc: Ask for bone marrow gravy and anchovy hollandaise.

items.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
items.desc: The dish they're famous for. Worth it even when full.

the-devonshire.name: The Devonshire
the-devonshire.note: WALK-IN ONLY. Expect a queue — it's a Premier League Saturday. Worth it.

three-greyhounds.name: The Three Greyhounds
three-greyhounds.note: Optional second stop. Best Guinness in Soho, mock-Tudor room from 1847.

the-wolseley.name: The Wolseley
the-wolseley.note: Built 1921 as a Wolseley Motors car showroom. Leave by 11:45 for the tour.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: Breakfast last orders are 11:30 — you're booked at 10:30, so don't dawdle.

sections.label: The one genuinely distinctive dish here

items.name: Smoked Haddock Kedgeree with poached egg
items.desc: Everything else is a hotel fry-up at Mayfair prices. This isn't.

sections.label: The other two to get, no overlap

items.name: Bubble & Squeak
items.desc: Wild mushrooms, fried duck egg.

items.name: Fried Haggis and Duck Eggs
items.desc: With whisky sauce.

items.name: Croissant au Beurre
items.desc: Arrives warm. The correct Wolseley ritual.

orderCard.suggested: One of each of the three above — all British-specific things you can't get at home
orderCard.skip: The English (£24.50) — reviewed as unremarkable for the price, and you'll get a better fry-up at Breakfast Club on Monday for £16.50. Also skip the pain au chocolat (dry). Ask for a table in the main room under the vaulted ceiling — the room is 80% of what you're paying for.

the-audley.name: The Audley
the-audley.note: Walk-in. Victorian stunner — look up at the ceiling.

ivy-asia.name: Ivy Asia St Paul's
ivy-asia.note: Green onyx floor, theatrical, fun. Views of St Paul's.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: You come for the glowing green onyx floor and the St Paul's view — but the small plates and robata are where the kitchen actually delivers.

items.name: Char Siu Pork Belly
items.desc: The dish reviewers consistently flag as both delicious and the best value here.

sections.label: Small plates — get four or five

items.name: Popcorn Shrimp
items.desc: Hot Dinners: excellent.

items.name: Seared Wagyu Beef Roll
items.desc: One roll for the theatre. Better value than the £55 Silver Shell, which is pure Instagram.

items.name: Orient N.12 Up Fashioned
items.desc: The cocktail programme is legitimately solid.

orderCard.suggested: Order like a sharing restaurant — 2 large plates plus 4–5 small plates for three, not one main each
orderCard.skip: Desserts are the weak link. Skip the £39.95 Golden Dragon; if you want one, the Ube Doughnuts £10.25. Better plan: skip dessert, go drink. Ask for a window table with the St Paul's view when booking and again on arrival.

sexy-fish.name: Sexy Fish
sexy-fish.note: Bar table reserved. Closes MIDNIGHT on Sundays. Damien Hirst art.

park-chinois.name: Park Chinois
park-chinois.note: Backup for Sexy Fish. Live music, 1930s Shanghai.

breakfast-club.name: The Breakfast Club Old Compton St

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

sections.label: Their own menu calls it the dish that made us famous

items.name: The All American
items.desc: Pancakes, bacon, British sausage, homestyle potatoes, sunny-side eggs, maple syrup. (D-list celebrity famous, per the menu.)

items.name: The Full Monty
items.desc: So one of you gets black pudding and the proper British version.

items.name: Fried Chicken, Bacon & Waffles
items.desc: Waffle, fried chicken breast, crispy bacon, sunny-side egg and gravy. The sleeper.

items.name: Pancakes with Marmite Maple Butter
items.desc: For the table. Sounds insane, it's their legendary item, three Americans should try it once.

items.name: Six hash browns with dips
items.desc: Add an egg £2, add black pudding or mushrooms £1.

orderCard.skip: Nothing. No bookings at Old Compton St and the queue is famous — 10:30 on a Monday is the smart slot, you'll walk straight in.

harrods.name: Harrods
harrods.note: Food hall, watch windows. No dress code.

dishoom-carnaby.name: Dishoom Carnaby
dishoom-carnaby.note: Last bookable slot. They NEVER ask for card details by phone — if someone calls asking, it's a scam.

orderCard.title: 🍛 What to order
orderCard.intro: All prices from the current Carnaby all-day menu.

items.name: House Black Daal
items.desc: Dishoom's signature. Black lentils cooked over 24 hours — dark, rich, almost buttery. One for the table minimum; regulars order two. This is the dish the restaurant is famous for.

sections.label: The centrepiece — pick one to share

items.name: Lamb Raan
items.desc: Fall-apart leg of lamb with saffron rice, caramelised onions and warming spices. The showstopper, and it feeds a table. No pre-order needed at Carnaby.

items.name: Chicken Berry Britannia
items.desc: Their biryani, sealed under pastry, with barberries. The other big shared plate.

sections.label: Grills — two or three between the three of you

items.name: Charred Lamb Chops
items.desc: Marinated overnight in papaya and yoghurt, grilled, finished with Kashmiri chilli sauce. Widely called the best thing on the menu.

items.name: Dishoom Chicken Tikka
items.desc: Family recipe using sweet vinegar instead of yoghurt — not like any tikka you've had.

items.name: Sheekh Kabab
items.desc: Minced lamb, coriander, cumin.

items.name: Gunpowder Potatoes
items.desc: New potatoes grilled and tossed in butter, aromatic seeds and herbs. Cult favourite.

items.name: Roomali Roti
items.desc: For mopping up the daal.

items.name: Permit Room cocktails
items.desc: Genuinely good list. The Bombay Colada and the East India Gimlet are the two people talk about.

items.name: House chai
items.desc: Worth one round even mid-meal.

orderCard.suggested: House Black Daal ×2 · Lamb Raan · Charred Lamb Chops · Dishoom Chicken Tikka · Gunpowder Potatoes · Roomali Roti
orderCard.footer: Roughly £35–40 a head with a drink.

connaught-bar.name: Connaught Bar
connaught-bar.note: Repeatedly voted one of the world's best bars. The tableside martini trolley is the bucket-list drink — they wheel it over and build it in front of you. Walk-in only, no reservations; Monday is the easiest night of the week. Smart casual.

orderCard.title: 🍸 What to order
orderCard.intro: How the trolley works: the black lacquer trolley is wheeled to your table and the drink is built in front of you. A hand-etched Connaught crystal glass is chilled with slow-frozen ice. You choose your bitters from the handmade house range — Tonka bean, Lavender, Cardamom, Coriander seed, or Dr Ago (Agostino Perrone's own bergamot-and-ginseng blend). Two dashes go in. Base is Tanqueray No.10 with a proprietary dry vermouth blend, always stirred, poured from height, spritzed with lemon oil, finished with a citrus spiral.

sections.label: All three of you, from the trolley

items.name: The Connaught Martini
items.desc: Order three with three different bitters — Dr Ago, Tonka, Lavender — so you can taste across.

items.name: Number 11
items.desc: Eleven years in development.

items.name: Vieux Connaught
items.desc: Zacapa 23, Johnnie Walker Blue, saffron smoke.

items.name: Seventy One Martini pairing
items.desc: Barrel-aged, served with 10g of Royal Siberian caviar on the house.

orderCard.suggested: Go after 9:30pm — the room quiets and the bartenders have time to talk you through it. Monday is the best night of the week.
orderCard.skip: Don't order off-menu classics; the house list is the point. Dress smart — no trainers, no sportswear. They do turn people away.

seven-dials-market.name: Seven Dials Market
seven-dials-market.note: Suggestion if you want a graze instead of the V&A.

palaces-parliament.name: Palaces & Parliament Walking Tour
palaces-parliament.note: Meet OUTSIDE The Ritz by the TWO RED PHONE BOXES. Arrive 11:50. 3 hours.

dfw-terminal-d.name: DFW Terminal D
dfw-terminal-d.address: 2337 South International Parkway, DFW Airport, TX 75261
dfw-terminal-d.note: International terminal. Lounge access with Business.

atmosphere-rooftop.name: Atmosphere Rooftop Bar
atmosphere-rooftop.note: Rooftop of The Ritz-Carlton. Falstaff 92 pts (2026). Sat 5pm–1am. Walk-in.

mesteren-laerlingen.name: Mesteren & Lærlingen
mesteren-laerlingen.note: The old butcher's bodega. Cheap, loud, ground floor, open til 01:00. Indoor smoking is permitted.

curfew.name: Curfew
curfew.note: Speakeasy behind a former bookstore's shelves. Serious cocktails, open til 01:00 Tuesdays. Small room — book a table.

cafe-hoppe.name: Café Hoppe
cafe-hoppe.note: Brown café since 1670. Always packed, spills onto the street. Open til 01:00. Walk in.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order

sections.label: The most Amsterdam thing three Americans can do

items.name: A kopstootje
items.desc: Amstel vaas €3.80 + Jonge Hoppe jenever €4.00. The little head-butt: a tulip glass of jenever filled to the brim beside a beer. You bend down and sip the first mouthful without hands, then chase with the beer. Hoppe has been a jenever house since 1670. Do a round of three.

items.name: Oude Corenwijn
items.desc: Aged, malty, whisky-adjacent.

items.name: IJwit, Brouwerij 't IJ, 30cl
items.desc: The local pick.

sections.label: Snacks — order early, the kitchen closes well before the bar

items.name: Amsterdamse ossenworst
items.desc: Raw beef sausage.

orderCard.skip: The nachos — wrong venue.
orderCard.suggested: Two rooms: the left-hand old tasting room has a sand and sawdust floor, is standing-only with no table service, and you order at the bar. That's the one you came for.

westminster-abbey.name: Westminster Abbey
westminster-abbey.note: £31 each, timed entry, book online. Closes 3:30 PM. Verger-guided tours bookable at the desk.

churchill-war-rooms.name: Churchill War Rooms
churchill-war-rooms.address: Clive Steps, King Charles Street, London SW1A 2AQ
churchill-war-rooms.note: £29.75pp. 9:30am–6pm, last entry 5pm. Book ahead. 5 min from Westminster Abbey. ⚠️ Underground, no step-free access.

red-lion-westminster.name: The Red Lion
red-lion-westminster.note: Mon 11:00–23:00. Grade II listed — 1890s mahogany bar-back and etched glass, and a working division bell that rings to summon MPs back to the House. Downing Street is a hundred yards away. Three handpumps, London Pride. Drinks only — don't eat here.

the-chandos.name: The Chandos
the-chandos.note: Mon 12:00–23:00. Sam Smith's — no website or Instagram, that's normal, not a closure. Cheapest proper pint in the West End. Go upstairs to the panelled Opera Room. Own-brewery beers only (no Guinness) and a house no-phones policy.

the-harp.name: The Harp
the-harp.note: Mon 11:00–23:00. CAMRA National Pub of the Year — the only central London pub ever to win it. Narrow room, walls of oil portraits, stained glass, no TV, no music. 3 regular + 5 rotating cask ales. No kitchen at all, so it's structurally impossible to ruin your appetite here.

old-coffee-house.name: The Old Coffee House
old-coffee-house.note: Mon 11:00–23:00. First licensed 1772, rebuilt 1894 — genuinely independent in a Soho full of chains. Ceiling-to-floor brass, taxidermy, oil paintings, music-hall memorabilia. Kitchen shuts at 3 PM, so by evening it's a pure drinking room.

the-clachan.name: The Clachan
the-clachan.note: Grade II listed, built as a Liberty draper's shop — spectacular carved ceiling. 60 seconds from Dishoom. The guaranteed fallback.

sky-garden.name: Sky Garden
sky-garden.note: Free, but you must book a timed slot ahead.

coach-and-horses.name: Coach & Horses
coach-and-horses.note: Jeffrey Bernard's old pub. Intact 1930s interior, wet-led with bar snacks only. Their old domain is dead and redirects — the pub is still trading.

hija-de-sanchez.name: Hija de Sanchez
hija-de-sanchez.note: Ex-Noma pastry chef's taqueria. 3 min walk from Warpigs, in Kødbyen. NOT at Reffen — older guides get this wrong.

door-74.name: Door 74
door-74.note: The original Amsterdam speakeasy, behind an unmarked door. World's 50 Best Bars alum. Cocktails €14–17. Closes midnight Thursdays. Book via WhatsApp +31 6 34045122.

cafe-de-plantage.name: Café-Restaurant de Plantage
cafe-de-plantage.note: Glass orangery beside Artis zoo. Local crowd, open til midnight. Use the Artisplein side entrance — the main door has 3 steps.

de-balie.name: De Balie
de-balie.note: Leidseplein's debate-and-film house. Journalists and students, not tourists.

bierfabriek.name: Bierfabriek
bierfabriek.note: 3 min from the hotel. Own-brewed beer, self-pour tap tables at the table, free peanuts. Open til midnight.

cafe-eik-en-linde.name: Café Eik en Linde
cafe-eik-en-linde.note: A genuine unreconstructed brown café — billiards, regulars, no concessions to tourism. Thu til 01:00. 300 yards from de Plantage, so pair them.

cafe-restaurant-amsterdam.name: Café-Restaurant Amsterdam
cafe-restaurant-amsterdam.note: The 1897 Haarlemmerweg pumping station. You eat in the old engine room — one of the original diesel engines still stands in it, and the hall is lit by 22 floodlights salvaged from the old Ajax stadium and the Olympic Stadium. Kitchen 17:00–22:00, open till midnight.

orderCard.title: 🍽 What to order
orderCard.intro: The shellfish counter is the signature here — it has its own menu.

items.name: Fruits de mer plateau
items.desc: Large €98 · extra €115.75.

items.name: Rib-eye béarnaise
items.desc: The most-praised meat dish.

items.name: Sticky toffee pudding
items.desc: The one everyone names.

orderCard.skip: Artichokes are currently off the menu — don't go looking for them.

blocks.title: Leave for DFW
blocks.desc: Terminal D. Do not cut this close — international check-in and security eat time.

blocks.title: Lounge
blocks.desc: Business class gets you in. First drink of the trip is on the ground.

blocks.title: BA 192 → London Heathrow
blocks.desc: Airbus A380, upper deck. Lands 10:55 AM tomorrow.

blocks.title: SLEEP ON THE PLANE
blocks.desc: Seriously. You land at 10:55 AM and go straight to a connection, then a driver, then dinner. The guy who watches four movies is the guy who dies on Friday.

trivia.q: What aircraft is BA 192 tonight?
trivia.a: An Airbus A380 — the double-decker superjumbo. Business class is upstairs.

trivia.q: How many time zones do we cross between Dallas and London?
trivia.a: Six. Dallas is UTC−5, London is UTC+1 in summer.

trivia.q: We take off at 7:40 PM and land at 10:55 AM. How long is the flight actually?
trivia.a: About nine hours. The other six are the clock jumping ahead.

discussion: What are you most looking forward to over the next 14 days?
Over/under: how many drinks do you have before we land?
Vote now, settle it Friday — who's getting absolutely wrecked by jet lag?
You get one do-over on this trip, no questions asked. When do you burn it?
One sentence: what would make this a 10 out of 10?

days.title: VIENNA — Arrival
days.subtitle: Land, drop bags, eat, easy night.

blocks.title: Land at Heathrow
blocks.desc: Connect to BA 724. Same booking reference — bags should through-check.

blocks.title: BA 724 → Vienna
blocks.desc: Lands 3:55 PM Vienna time.

blocks.title: Airport Driver → SO/ Vienna
blocks.desc: Prepaid. Confirmation AVBO53170. Driver meets you in arrivals.

blocks.title: Check in · SO/ Vienna
blocks.desc: Settle in, shower off the flight. Res QKJDDGMM, 2 rooms.

blocks.title: First drink of the trip — lobby bar
blocks.desc: Das Loft upstairs is closed for renovation. The lobby bar is the move.

blocks.title: Dinner · Cucina Itameshi
blocks.desc: Italian-Japanese. 5 min walk from the hotel.

res.note: 19:00–22:30, party of 3. Shrimp allergy noted on the booking. €25pp no-show fee.

blocks.title: Nightcap · Klyo
blocks.desc: Riverfront canal bar. One or two, then bed — tour in the morning.

trivia.q: "Itameshi" is a real culinary term. What two cuisines does it combine?
trivia.a: Italian and Japanese — 'Ita' for Italian, 'meshi' being Japanese for a meal.

trivia.q: Klyo sits on the water. What water?
trivia.a: The Donaukanal — the Danube Canal, an arm of the Danube running right through central Vienna.

trivia.q: What do Austrians actually call Vienna?
trivia.a: Wien. Pronounced 'veen'.

discussion: Vienna in one word. Go around, no repeats.
Who handled that flight the best? Who looked like absolute shit getting off it?
What's the first thing today that felt genuinely foreign?
Best bite at Cucina Itameshi — and was Italian-Japanese the right call?
Nominate someone for 'most likely to fall asleep at this table.'

days.title: VIENNA — Tour, Art, and the Big Night
days.subtitle: Pace yourself early. Tonight is the night.

blocks.title: Hotel breakfast
blocks.desc: Eat properly. Ready in the lobby by 10:45.

blocks.title: Private walking tour · Guydeez
blocks.desc: Hotel pickup. Three hours, custom route.

res.note: Guide collects you at SO/ Vienna.

blocks.title: Albertina
blocks.desc: Monet to Picasso, Dürer drawings, Habsburg state rooms. ~90 min inside, then a drink at the museum café.

suggestions.title: Bail early and nap
suggestions.desc: Genuinely the smart play. You have a 2 AM night ahead. Nobody will judge you.

blocks.title: Back to the hotel — shower and change
blocks.desc: This is the outfit change. Collared shirt, real shoes. Volksgarten later runs on discretion.
blocks.warn: Lay out the smart outfit NOW, not at 11 PM.

blocks.title: Dinner · Zum Schwarzen Kameel
blocks.desc: Ground floor Wiener Brasserie. In business since 1618.

blocks.title: Krypt
blocks.desc: Falstaff 90 points. Vaulted cellar, 23-foot marble-and-walnut counter, you take an elevator DOWN to it. Open until 2–3 AM Fridays.

blocks.title: Volksgarten — if the group's rolling
blocks.desc: Thu–Sat, 11 PM–6 AM, 21+. Dress smart — no sneakers, no shorts.
blocks.warn: GO-OUT NIGHT. This is the one.

suggestions.title: Fallback: Klyo
suggestions.desc: Canal bar, lower stakes, still open late.

suggestions.title: Fallback: hotel bar
suggestions.desc: Zero shame in this. Tomorrow is a free day.

trivia.q: The Albertina owns one of the most famous watercolours in art history — a small brown animal painted by Dürer in 1502. What is it?
trivia.a: The Young Hare (Feldhase). It's one of the most reproduced images in Western art.

trivia.q: Zum Schwarzen Kameel has been serving Vienna since what year?
trivia.a: 1618. It's older than most countries you can name.

trivia.q: Volksgarten sits inside a public garden famous for one particular flower. Which?
trivia.a: Roses — the Volksgarten rose garden holds thousands of bushes.

discussion: What's the one thing the guide told us that actually stuck?
Most out-of-pocket thing anyone said before noon. Quote it exactly.
Albertina — genuinely great, or were we just pretending to be cultured for an afternoon?
On the record right now: who makes it into Volksgarten and who taps out like a bitch?
Whoever taps out first tonight buys the first round in Copenhagen. Name him.

blocks.title: Sleep in. No agenda.
blocks.desc: The Lipizzaner horses got cut. Nothing is booked until 11:30. Use it.

blocks.title: Lunch · Café Landtmann
blocks.desc: Sidewalk-level terrace on the Ring. Freud's café, opened 1873.

blocks.title: The Loop — Stephansplatz → Graben → Kohlmarkt → Verde
blocks.desc: Stephansplatz to start. Graben for the Juwelier Wagner Rolex windows. Kohlmarkt for a Demel Sachertorte stop. Then Verde around 3:30 for pizza and spritzes.

subStops.name: Graben · Juwelier Wagner
subStops.note: Rolex windows. Window shopping only — the real appointment is Copenhagen.

suggestions.title: Prater + Riesenrad
suggestions.desc: The 1897 ferris wheel, 10 min from the hotel. Good pre-dinner move.

suggestions.title: Film Festival am Rathausplatz
suggestions.desc: FREE. 25+ food stalls, giant screen, runs until Sep 6. Great low-effort evening.

blocks.title: Sunset drinks · Atmosphere Rooftop
blocks.desc: Rooftop of The Ritz-Carlton, looking over the Ring. Falstaff 92 pts. Walk in — open til 1am Saturdays.
blocks.note: Replaces Das Loft, which is shut for renovation until Sep 3.

suggestions.title: Or just Klyo
suggestions.desc: Canal bar, 5 min from the hotel, zero effort.

blocks.title: Dinner · Lugeck
blocks.desc: The schnitzel. Figlmüller family.

suggestions.title: Fallback: Figlmüller Bäckerstraße
suggestions.desc: Sister restaurant, same schnitzel, 4 min away.

blocks.title: Nightcap · Motto am Fluss
blocks.desc: Canal deck at Schwedenplatz.

blocks.title: PACK TONIGHT
blocks.desc: 7:00 AM pickup tomorrow. Pack before you go to bed, not at 6:40 AM.
blocks.warn: 7 AM pickup. Pack tonight.

trivia.q: Café Landtmann opened in 1873 and was the regular café of which famous Viennese thinker?
trivia.a: Sigmund Freud. He had a usual table.

trivia.q: Demel and Hotel Sacher fought a legal battle lasting decades. Over what?
trivia.a: Who had the right to call their cake the 'Original Sachertorte'.

trivia.q: The Riesenrad ferris wheel in the Prater was built in what year?
trivia.a: 1897 — for Emperor Franz Joseph I's golden jubilee. It's one of the oldest still operating.

discussion: Score last night out of 10 — and you have to justify the number.
Who is the most hungover right now? Don't lie, we can all see you.
Best decision made last night. Worst decision made last night.
Lugeck's schnitzel vs everything else we've eaten. Where does it land?
One more day in Vienna, no budget, no rules. What are we doing?

blocks.title: Airport Driver → VIE
blocks.desc: Prepaid. Confirmation AZBO50842. Be in the lobby at 6:50.

blocks.title: SAS → Copenhagen
blocks.desc: Lands 11:55 AM. Conf BLXH8G.

blocks.desc: Res 1209031060 / 1209031059 (Grant). Paid in Round 1.

blocks.title: Dinner · Esmée
blocks.desc: Ask for the Orangerie room — go for the room, order smart.

trivia.a: The King's New Square.

blocks.title: Dinner · Sokkelund
blocks.desc: Frederiksberg. Neighbourhood bistro, locals' spot.

suggestions.title: Backup: Madklubben Frederiksberg

trivia.q: Which fairy-tale author lived at three separate addresses on Nyhavn?

trivia.q: Those colourful Nyhavn townhouses were originally what?

blocks.desc: Kødbyen meatpacking district. WALK-IN, order at the counter, 23 Mikkeller taps. Meat sells out — this is beers AND food.

blocks.title: Dinner · Café-Restaurant Amsterdam
blocks.desc: The 1897 Haarlemmerweg pumping station. You eat in the old engine room — one of the original diesel engines is still standing in it, under 22 floodlights salvaged from the old Ajax stadium and the Olympic Stadium.
blocks.warn:
🚋 THE ONLY DINNER THAT ISN'T WALKABLE — about 3 miles out in Westerpark. Plan the journey.
THERE: Tram 5 → Van Hallstraat, then a 4-minute walk. About 30 min door to door.
BACK: Tram 5 runs until 00:48 and goes straight to Elandsgracht, Rozengracht and Leidseplein with no transfer — the right direction if the night continues. Night bus N88 hourly after that (01:51, 02:51, 03:51). Taxi €18–28, about 12 minutes.

suggestions.title: ③ De Balie

suggestions.title: ④ Café Eik en Linde

suggestions.title: ⑤ Canvas @ Volkshotel

trivia.q: The tour starts at the National Monument on Dam Square. What does it commemorate?

trivia.q: Tonight's dining room used to be what, and what's still standing in it?
trivia.a: The 1897 Haarlemmerweg water-pumping station. One of the original diesel engines is still in the room, lit by 22 floodlights salvaged from the old Ajax stadium and the Olympic Stadium.

trivia.q: What are those hooks sticking out of the top of Amsterdam's canal houses for?
trivia.a: Hoisting furniture up through the windows. The staircases are far too narrow.

topAlert.title: THE THING THAT WILL COST YOU MONEY
topAlert.body:
Amsterdam metro makes you TAP TWICE — once going in, once going out. Same card both times. Forget to tap out and you're charged a €4 penalty instead of about €2.

Use the same physical card, or the same phone, for every single tap. Pick one at 5 PM and don't switch.

Four taps total tonight.

steps.title: HOTEL TO THE METRO
lines: Out the front door of the Radisson Blu, Rusland 17. Turn onto Kloveniersburgwal — the canal street beside the hotel.
Walk NORTH along the canal, water on your LEFT. North = away from the opera house end, toward the busy Chinatown end.
Straight on for about a quarter mile, roughly 5 minutes. Over a couple of small bridges. Do not turn.
The canal opens into a big square with a castle-looking tower in the middle — that's Nieuwmarkt, and the tower is the Waag.
Metro entrance is on the square: white M on a blue sign, stairs and escalator down.
steps.tip: Lost? Ask anyone for "Nieuwmarkt." Everyone speaks English.

steps.title: THE METRO OUT
lines: TAP IN at the gate. (Tap #1)
Take METRO 54, direction GEIN. Platform signs read "54 → Gein."

alert.title: WRONG TRAINS
alert.body:
Nieuwmarkt is also served by line 51 and line 53. Neither goes to the concert.

If the front of the train doesn't say 54 Gein, don't get on. Another comes in a few minutes.

linesAfter: Ride 9 stops: Waterlooplein · Weesperplein · Wibautstraat · Amstel · Spaklerweg · Van der Madeweg · Duivendrecht · Strandvliet · BIJLMER ARENA.
Get off at BIJLMER ARENA. Big bright busy station, everyone in band shirts gets off here, stadium visible out the window.
steps.tip: Gone too far? The next stop is Bullewijk — small and quiet. Cross the platform and come back one stop.

steps.title: DINNER · BLVD020
lines: Exit the station following signs for ArenAPoort / Johan Cruijff Boulevard.
You come out on a wide flat pedestrian boulevard — stadium on one side, restaurants on the other. Impossible to get lost.
BLVD020 is on that strip, number 139.

alert.title: NO RESERVATIONS ON EVENT NIGHTS
alert.body:
Walk-in only. That's why you're there at 5:25 — by 6:00 it's full of the concert crowd.

Burgers, casual food, beers. About €20–30 each. If it's rammed, the same boulevard has a row of other restaurants.

Eat something — the venue only sells snacks.

steps.title: THE VENUE · AFAS Live
lines: Same boulevard, keep walking, big lit-up sign. Doors 6:30.
You're in the VIP LOGE — Row 3, Seats 13/14/15.
Tell staff at the main entrance you're VIP Loge and they'll direct you. Row 3 sits on a small raised platform with space beside it; their team assists on the night.
8:00 PM — Robert Finley opens, then The Black Keys.

home.title: GETTING HOME
home.headline: Metro 54, direction CENTRAAL STATION. Last train ~00:30.
home.sub: Show ends ~10:45 PM — you have well over an hour of slack.
lines: Wait 20–30 minutes after the show before walking to the station, or you're in a crush of 15,000 people. Have one more drink. No rush.
Walk back down the boulevard to Bijlmer ArenA station (2 min, same way you came).
TAP IN. (Tap #3)
Platform for METRO 54, direction CENTRAAL STATION.

alert.title: WRONG DIRECTION, WRONG LINE
alert.body:
Must say CENTRAAL, not Gein. Gein takes you deeper into the suburbs.

Line 50 also runs from this station — do not take it. It goes west and leaves you nowhere near the hotel.

linesAfter: Ride 9 stops: Strandvliet · Duivendrecht · Van der Madeweg · Spaklerweg · Amstel · Wibautstraat · Weesperplein · Waterlooplein · NIEUWMARKT.
Get off at NIEUWMARKT. TAP OUT. (Tap #4)
Up to the square. Put the Waag tower behind you and walk SOUTH down Kloveniersburgwal, water on your RIGHT. A quarter mile, 5 minutes. Rusland is on your right. Home.
home.tip: Missed the stop / fell asleep? Next stop is Centraal Station — end of the line, everyone gets off, staff are there. From Centraal it's a €12–15 taxi or a 15-minute walk home. Not a disaster.

taxi.title: TAXI — if the metro's shut or it all goes wrong
lines: Taxi rank is directly outside Bijlmer ArenA station.
€45–55, about 20 minutes.
Uber is often cheaper (€35–45) — order it from the boulevard, not inside the venue where there's no signal.
taxi.showDriver: Radisson Blu Hotel, Rusland 17, 1012 CK Amsterdam
taxi.warn: Never take a ride from anyone who approaches you. Official rank or an app, nothing else.

preflight.title: BEFORE YOU LEAVE THE HOTEL
items: Decide your tap card — one card or one phone, all four taps
Tickets loaded and screenshotted (venue wifi is useless)
Hotel address saved: Radisson Blu, Rusland 17
A jacket — September, out till midnight
Agree the meeting point out loud: the taxi rank outside Bijlmer ArenA station

separated.title: IF YOU GET SEPARATED
separated.body:
Don't wander the venue — 15,000 people, no signal inside.

Go to the taxi rank outside Bijlmer ArenA station. Wait 15 minutes.

If nobody shows, take the metro or a taxi home alone and text the group. Everyone knows the address. Everyone can get home alone. Nobody stays out looking for anybody.

countdownPushes.title: 🇪🇺 19 days till European On My Face comes to life
countdownPushes.body: Three idiots, four countries, fourteen days. It's actually happening.

countdownPushes.title: 🍺 18 days until you're drinking beer in Vienna
countdownPushes.body: First one's at the SO/Vienna lobby bar, about an hour after we land. Earn it on the plane.

countdownPushes.title: 🎸 17 days until blackout at the Black Keys
countdownPushes.body: VIP Loge, Row 3, seats 13/14/15. Robert Finley opens. AFAS Live, Amsterdam.

countdownPushes.title: 🇬🇧 16 days — and some of you still haven't done the UK ETA
countdownPushes.body: £20, official app, takes about 3 working days. They will not let you into the country without it. Do it on the toilet right now.

countdownPushes.title: 🥩 15 days until schnitzel bigger than your pecker
countdownPushes.body: Lugeck, Friday the 29th. It hangs off the plate. That's the point.

countdownPushes.title: 🕺 Two weeks until Volksgarten at 2 AM
countdownPushes.body: On the record now: who taps out first? Loser buys the first round in Copenhagen.

countdownPushes.title: 🎨 13 days until we pretend to like art
countdownPushes.body: Albertina on the 28th, Van Gogh on the 4th. Book the Van Gogh tickets — they actually sell out.

countdownPushes.title: 🌈 12 days until Nyhavn
countdownPushes.body: The postcard one. Colored houses, boats, beers by the water. Copenhagen on the 30th.

countdownPushes.title: 🌭 11 days until Reffen
countdownPushes.body: Fifty-plus food stalls on an old shipyard, reached by boat. Tacos, smash burgers, Korean BBQ. Come hungry.

countdownPushes.title: 🔟 10 days. Double digits for the last time.
countdownPushes.body: Ten days from now you're on a plane with a drink in your hand.

countdownPushes.title: 🍖 9 days until Warpigs
countdownPushes.body: Texas barbecue in Copenhagen, 23 Mikkeller taps, meat sells out. Walk-in only, so we go early.

countdownPushes.title: 🍸 8 days until the Connaught martini trolley
countdownPushes.body: They wheel it to the table and build it in front of you. One of the best bars on earth. Last Monday of the trip.

countdownPushes.title: 7️⃣ One week. Seven days.
countdownPushes.body: A week from tonight you're somewhere over the Atlantic in a lie-flat seat.

countdownPushes.title: 🍛 6 days until Dishoom black daal
countdownPushes.body: Lentils cooked 24 hours. We're ordering two. Non-negotiable.

countdownPushes.title: 🎡 5 days until the Riesenrad
countdownPushes.body: Same ferris wheel since 1897. Ten minutes from the hotel. Vienna, day two.

countdownPushes.title: 🧳 4 days. Start actually packing.
countdownPushes.body: Two adapter types — C/F for Europe, G for London. Battery pack. One decent shirt. Walking shoes you've already broken in.

countdownPushes.title: 🛂 3 days. Passport, ETA, tickets.
countdownPushes.body: Check all three tonight. Passport valid through December, ETA approved, Westminster and Van Gogh booked. No surprises Wednesday.

countdownPushes.title: ✌️ 2 days
countdownPushes.body: Two more sleeps in Texas.

countdownPushes.title: 🚨 TOMORROW. IT'S TOMORROW.
countdownPushes.body:
BA 192 out of DFW, 7:40 PM. Leave for the airport by 5, Terminal D.

PACK TONIGHT. Not tomorrow. Tomorrow-you will be useless.

countdownPushes.title: ✈️ THE TIME IS NOW
countdownPushes.body:
WHEELS UP 7:40 PM. CAR LEAVES AT 5. TERMINAL D.

PASSPORT. ETA. BATTERY PACK. ONE DECENT SHIRT.

FOUR COUNTRIES. FOURTEEN DAYS. THREE IDIOTS.

EUROPEAN ON MY FACE IS LIVE. LET'S GO BOYS. 🤠
